methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: the objective of this research is to identify the challenges found by organizations during the implementation of ISO 50001:2011, according to the literature

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Systematic literature review whose synthesis is of implementation challenges/barriers to ISO 50001, not of EnPI/EnB measurement models. The review characterises no model (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach for any indicator or baseline). EnPI/EnB content appears only incidentally: 'Difficulty in determining the energy baseline and energy performance indicators' is listed as one of eleven challenges. Per the v2.3 review/synthesis decision tree step 1 (no model characterised for the objects central to the synthesis) and the incidental-mention rule, this is ineligible.

paper_type.evidence_quote: To carry out a systematic literature review to provide a synthesis of the

stage1.notes: Review of ISO 50001 implementation challenges (206 documents -> 17 articles -> 11 challenges). 'Difficulty in determining the energy baseline and energy performance indicators' is the 2nd-most-cited challenge (6/17), but no EnPI/EnB model is identified or characterised; EnPI/EnB is incidental. Ineligible -> stage2/stage3 null.
